preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, HJ calls, CO calls, hero(BTN) to act facing 2.5bb call w/ 3 villains already in
rationale_summary: 87s in BTN closing 3 callers + UTG open — strong implied-odds play; suited connectors realize equity well in 4-way SRP IP. Squeeze 3-bet is too thin into 4 villains' combined cold-call range; fold gives up too much implied-odds equity.

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, hero(BTN) calls, SB calls, BB calls
rationale_summary: TPGK (K-J kicker) on K-high dry rainbow flop facing CO 25% c-bet in 4-way IP. CO's range is wide for 25% sizing (incl. air); raise is too thin for thin value against SB+BB ranges that still need to act. Pure CALL maintains pot control, keeps CO's bluffs in, plays clean turn. RAISE would charge SB/BB out — but they're also folding to flat anyway.

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, hero(SB) calls, BB calls
rationale_summary: Nut FD + 2 overcards + nut flush blocker, SB OOP with 3 villains behind in 4-way SRP. Donk-bet from SB is dominated GTO move; CO is the preflop aggressor and ranges include c-bet frequency. CHECK to induce CO's c-bet, then check-raise OOP for protection + fold equity from middle range of CO/BTN. The blocker effect (As) reduces villain nut flush combos.

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, hero(MP) calls, CO calls, BTN calls
rationale_summary: AJ on Q-J-9 two-tone = mid-pair-good-kicker + open-ended straight draw (KT/T8) + backdoor flush blockers. MP cold-called UTG → range capped (no JJ+; no AK 3-bet). Strong hand + good blockers (no AQ in MP cold-call range, only QJ-suited at most). RAISE for value + protection + fold equity vs CO/BTN floats. Size ~3x for SRP 4-way (cap CO/BTN to nut combos; charge weaker pair+draws).

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, hero(SB) calls, BB calls; flop checked through 4-way
rationale_summary: TT was overpair on flop 8-5-2; J turn drops TT to under-pair vs any J (J-x is in CO's c-bet range that he checked = could still hold). Flop checked through 4-way → all ranges capped to mid-strength (no monsters bet; no draws bet either). SB OOP turn: betting commits 3-way+ to thin value/protection on a card that helps villains. CHECK is GTO — let CO/BTN/BB declare; can call small turn bet but lead is dominated.
